correctness.rationale: PASS: Independent uniform area sampling yields sector offsets with normalized density sec^2(t)/(2 tan(pi/n)); the radius cancels in the diameter-disk condition X dot Y<=0. For odd n, modular differences count r or r+1 favorable sectors according to whether alpha/2<|T_X-T_Y|<3alpha/2. The band probability is an explicit two-integral sec^2-weighted calculation, converted algebraically to B(z). For even n, central inversion makes the probability 1/2. For odd n, the circle-folded offset density is symmetric unimodal and its self-convolution has strictly larger centered-half-circle mass, yielding the already known alternating sign. Uniform density expansion cancels constant and linear terms in the centered band, leaving an exact quartic correlation integral J=-5/192; I independently integrated the kernel -(u-2)(3u^4+6u^3-8u^2-16u+8)/90 and confirmed J=-5/192. Hence alpha=pi/n gives the fifth-order term with O(n^-7) after a smooth even expansion. The source verifier separately checks sector signs and numerical quadratures; finite checks cannot establish all n.
